cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant coastal metropolis famous for the Sydney Opera House, Harbour Bridge, and golden beaches.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: A cultural hub known for its art-filled laneways, world-class coffee culture, and scenic Yarra River.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A bustling blend of ultramodern skyscrapers, neon-lit streets, and historic shrines.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Famous for its classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, and traditional wooden houses.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A magnificent 12th-century temple complex and the largest religious monument in the world.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: An iconic white-marble architectural masterpiece in Agra celebrated for its intricate craftsmanship.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: An island paradise renowned for turquoise lagoons, coral reefs, and overwater bungalows.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: A lively crescent-shaped beach in Rio de Janeiro famous for golden sands and ocean views.
